title: fix(spec)!: a query where of the wrong kind answers one fields[] entry that names the shapes it takes
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH
Fixes #35500

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skills/ page names the `query.where` refusal or its `Invalid input` entries, or reads `fields[]` / `issues[]` by position or count

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:通过数据接口查询时,如果筛选条件写成了数字、字符串或空值,被拒时只返回一条说明,写清筛选条件应该是条件对象还是筛选数组;不再返回两条一模一样、什么也没说的「输入无效」。
- 为什么做:修的是数据接口查询被拒时原因说不清的问题(上一张同类卡的后续)。主要调用方是通过数据接口写查询的 AI,它看不到原因只能乱猜重试。
- 出错会怎样:按条数或位置读错误清单、或专找那句「输入无效」的调用方会读到不同内容;正常查询不受影响,元数据保存的错误清单在同类嵌套情况下也少一条;不涉及存储数据,撤回这一个 PR 即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:批准或合并这个 PR;它是申报了收窄的破坏性改动,席位不能自己落地。

## What changes

A query's `where` on the data API is `z.union([FilterArraySchema, DataEngineFilterSchema])`, and both members are unions themselves. Handed `42`, a string or `null`, each member failed only because the value was the wrong kind, but the shared branch selection did not read a member that is a union as a kind mismatch. So it selected both members, and each emitted its own unexplained `{ field: 'query.where', code: 'invalid_shape', message: 'Invalid input' }`. The caller got two identical entries and no cause. Measured at `main` `236c8044acb`, after #37083 had already dropped the explained outer head. #37083 is not released yet and ships in the same release as this, so a released client's before is the card's reading at `f6902e950`: three identical entries for `where: 42`, and five entries (four bare) for the malformed AST. The changeset's FROM lines are written against that.

- Policy (`packages/spec/src/shared/union-branch-policy.ts`): `isKindMismatchOnly` now also counts a branch-root `invalid_union` with zod's bare default message whose every branch is itself kind-mismatch-only, by the same rule, so depth does not matter. A nested union that declares its own `error` sentence stays informative. A nested union with `errors: []` keeps its old reading. `ZOD_UNION_DEFAULT_MESSAGE` moves into this module, because the selection now reads it; the mapper re-exports it unchanged for its pin, and it stays package-internal.
- The same rule in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s copy (`protocol-metadata-issues.ts`), so the data API's `fields[]`, the terminal renderer and the four lists `zodIssuesToMetadataIssues` feeds reach one verdict. Those four are a refused save's `issues[]` (`422 INVALID_METADATA`), a stored item's `_diagnostics.errors`, the seed-request refusal's `issues`, and the unmanaged-import `400`. This is what ruling record 7010280743 requires: the two machine lists say the same thing.
- The cause sentence (`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`, `TransportFilterValueSchema`): a value of the wrong kind (not an object or array) gets one sentence naming both accepted shapes, a condition object such as `{ "status": "open" }` or a filter array such as `["status", "=", "open"]`. An array or an object keeps zod's default, so its located causes speak and the bare head is still dropped in their favour. It covers every spelling of the slot (`where`, `$filter`, `filter`, `filters`) for a number, a string or a boolean. `null` is refused with it only on `where`; the other three spellings are `.nullable()` and accept `null` as no filter.
- Selection side effect: such a member was one issue long, so under "fewest issues wins" it could out-rank a sibling member with several located causes. That sibling is now selected, so in that case a list gains its located entries where one bare entry stood.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, `fix(spec)!`, BREAKING banner, FROM / TO, one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

The claim's file surface was widened to the policy layer before this was built (seat decision, option A of os-dev-report 7146729179; the amendment is on the card).

## Tests

All readings below are from the shared verify lock on a shared box.

<details><summary>New pins</summary>

- `packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.test.ts`, new describe: through the real `FindDataRequestSchema`, `42`, a string, `null` and a boolean each answer exactly one entry, `[['query.where', 'invalid_shape']]`, whose message is not zod's default and names both shapes. `$filter` answers the same entry at `query.$filter`. The malformed AST `[['status','=','open'],'and']` answers exactly `[query.where min_items, query.where.1 invalid_shape 'Invalid input']`. CONTROL: a filter object, a filter array and a logical filter array still parse. Plus a synthetic union of bare-kind unions answering one entry.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/union-branch-policy.parity.test.ts`: a new corpus fixture (renderer and wire agree pair for pair), the recursion, a sentence-carrying nested union staying informative, and `errors: []` keeping its reading. `ZOD_UNION_DEFAULT_MESSAGE` was added to the package-internal roster.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/union-branch-policy.cross-package-parity.test.ts`: two section-2 fixtures, a synthetic nested bare-kinds union and the real query door with `where: 42`. All three walks give the same paths and messages. `ZOD_UNION_DEFAULT_MESSAGE` was added to the section-1 symbol roster.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts`: the envelope walk says the nested bare-kinds union once, a sentence-carrying member is still heard, and a CONTROL member with a located cause is still expanded.
- `packages/rest/src/zod-union-fields.test.ts`, new top-level describe, which runs the real `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query` route over ObjectQL, SqlDriver (sqlite) and the metadata protocol. For `42`, a string and `null`: `400`, `code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'`, exactly `[['query.where', 'invalid_shape']]` with the shape sentence, and the driver is never read. For the malformed AST: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields` equal to the two entries above, and no read. CONTROL: a filter object and a filter array are served `200` with the right rows.

The new pins assert the `field`, `code`, status and entry count exactly. They check the sentence by the two shapes it names (`condition object`, `filter array`), not by its full wording.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Renderer: `formatZodError` / the CLI take the same rule, because they share the policy. A wrong-kind `where` prints one line, not one per member.
- Positional reader: `readDeclaredQueryNumber` (`rest-server.ts`) reads `fields[0]?.message`. A declared number schema has no nested bare-kinds union, so it does not move.
- Docs: `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx` already says a bare union entry is "kept only when nothing does", and that stays true, so it is not edited.
- Noted, not fixed (same door, different defect): `query.$filter: { "$and": 42 }` answers `field: 'query.where.$and'`, `code: 'required'`. The value is present, and the field names the folded slot, not the one the caller sent. Reported to the seat for filing.
- Read first, by risk: `packages/spec/src/shared/union-branch-policy.ts` (`isKindMismatchOnlyUnion`), then `TransportFilterValueSchema` in `data-engine.zod.ts`, then `union-branch-policy.cross-package-parity.test.ts` section 2.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.test.ts`. Every test should be green, including the describe "a wrong-typed query where answers one entry that names the shapes".
- A contract-tier review is owed: this is a declared narrowing.
